items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I was there when Louie first get off the boat, you know, when he came from -- Cuesth and Fate left Charlie (unintelligible) in Big Marable, and he came down, and Louie always was a very fine fellow.

ctx.x: Yeah. (Unintelligible) used to come by out there and stop. He was crazy about that little five piece group we had, and on his way over (unintelligible) moved to the -- Uncle Joe Oliver whatchacallit, (unintelligible) a job, he'd always stop in to hear these there when we used five pieces and say, okay, Pops. We never called him Pops them. We called him Louie. Well, who else was in this band with you?
